Conclusion. The result follows by combining Steps 1-3 through polynomial approximation and the compactness of the spectral family.

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via analytic interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_01330021 \cdot C_01330022 \cdot C_01330023\).
